name: BOAZ
canonical: Boaz, a mighty man of wealth of Bethlehem, a broad-shouldered prosperous Hebrew landowner of about fifty, sun-bronzed olive skin, a strong kind weather-creased face, dark hair greying at the temples and a full square trimmed beard, wearing a fine wheat-gold layered robe with a wide woven girdle and a russet head-cloth, ears of barley and threshing-floor dust about him, the easy bearing of a generous kinsman-redeemer
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
